snippet.title: Wildcard | Announcement Trailer (2022)
snippet.description:
The Official Wildcard Announcement Trailer

Prepare yourself for the next evolution in gaming! Watch the official announcement trailer for Wildcard, a groundbreaking PvP strategic action game where every match is a high-stakes battle of strategy, skill, and excitement.

What is Wildcard?
Wildcard is a third-person, 2v2 Collectible Card Action Game (CCAG) that seamlessly blends fast-paced arena combat with strategic deck building. As a champion, you battle in real-time, summoning powerful creatures from your deck to fight alongside you. Master dynamic abilities, outplay opponents with skillful action mechanics, and harness the power of your summons in a thrilling fusion of collectible card strategy and third-person action combat—all set in a live, interactive arena.

WISHLIST / PLAYTESTING : 
http://play.wildcardgame.com/steam 

DISCORD:
https://discord.gg/QZRgv9M2UZ

See you in the Arena!
Website / https://www.wildcardgame.com/
Wishlist on Steam & sign up for Closed Alpha playtesting: http://play.wildcardgame.com/steam
